algorithm-of-thoughts.model_api_controls: prefer external solver or executable representation when available. Distinct from provider thinking budgets; algorithm-style decomposition still needs evals and may be replaceable by reasoning APIs on simple tasks.
algorithm-of-thoughts.failure_modes: shallow search, state-tracking errors, false confidence.
algorithm-of-thoughts.caveat: the template is a lightweight approximation of a search procedure.
algorithm-of-thoughts.best_use: constrained problem solving where the algorithm is known.
algorithm-of-thoughts.avoid_when: no clear algorithm exists or examples are too complex to fit.

chain-of-verification.model_api_controls: source access, retrieval, citation checker, trace grading, eval rubric. CoVe is an independent verification procedure — not the same as provider reasoning/thinking controls.
chain-of-verification.failure_modes: self-verification that rubber-stamps errors, weak source checks, ungrounded citation repair.
chain-of-verification.caveat: Verification should be grounded in independent evidence; do not confuse CoVe with hidden-reasoning API modes.
chain-of-verification.best_use: factual generation, summaries, research notes, and hallucination-prone answers.
chain-of-verification.avoid_when: verification cannot access better evidence than the draft.

context-engineering.model_api_controls: context window, URL context, retrieval query, reranker, compression policy, prompt caching, memory scope, tool mode, provider reasoning/thinking budgets when long-context reasoning is the bottleneck.
context-engineering.cost_latency: variable; can be high with long context or retrieval.
context-engineering.failure_modes: irrelevant retrieval, prompt injection, context overflow, stale cached context, stale memory, lost middle facts.
context-engineering.caveat: context quality often matters more than clever wording.
context-engineering.best_use: private corpora, long-running agents, large-context work, RAG, and production workflows.
context-engineering.avoid_when: a simple prompt already contains all needed information.

sources.title: A Survey of Context Engineering for LLMs

eval-driven-prompt-optimization.model_api_controls:
track model snapshot, decoding, reasoning effort, schema version, and tool definitions.
 Prefer provider eval platforms and fixed regression sets; never select prompt variants by vibe alone.
eval-driven-prompt-optimization.cost_latency: high upfront; lower regression risk later.
eval-driven-prompt-optimization.failure_modes: overfitting, benchmark leakage, optimizing the wrong metric.
eval-driven-prompt-optimization.caveat: automatic prompt search is not a substitute for representative evals.
eval-driven-prompt-optimization.best_use: production prompts, routers, classifiers, extraction tasks, and prompts with measurable outcomes.
eval-driven-prompt-optimization.avoid_when: there is no stable task definition or eval set.

evaluation-flywheel.model_api_controls: provider eval platform, agent evals, custom eval harness, trace grading, scheduled evals, monitoring, datasets/graders (see OpenAI evals).
evaluation-flywheel.cost_latency: upfront cost; lower regression risk later.
evaluation-flywheel.failure_modes: unrepresentative tests, optimizing the wrong metric, silent model/retrieval/tool drift.
evaluation-flywheel.caveat: eval quality depends on representative cases and stable scoring.
evaluation-flywheel.best_use: production prompts, repeated workflows, high-stakes outputs, and shared prompt libraries; prefer official eval platforms when available (e.g. OpenAI evals).
evaluation-flywheel.avoid_when: a one-off exploratory prompt does not need maintenance.

expert-panel-discussion.model_api_controls: source requirements, structured evidence fields, review gate, decision log. Simulated multi-persona panels are NOT official multi-agent product APIs (OpenAI Agents handoffs/tools); do not invent product orchestration claims from panel roleplay.
expert-panel-discussion.failure_modes: roleplay verbosity, false authority, unsupported consensus, groupthink, conflating simulated panels with production agent frameworks.
expert-panel-discussion.caveat:
prefer [Self-Refine](#self-refine) or [Chain-of-Verification](#chain-of-verification) when verification is the goal; use this pattern when perspective coverage itself is the deliverable. For lightweight exploratory brainstorming, see [PanelGPT](#panelgpt). Not a replacement for real expertise.
 For production multi-agent systems, follow official agent framework docs (tools, handoffs, evals) rather than persona roleplay alone.
expert-panel-discussion.best_use: decision preparation where opposing views, assumptions, and evidence gaps must be surfaced.
expert-panel-discussion.avoid_when: the output needs domain-certified advice, stakeholder approval, or a cheap single-pass answer.

graph-of-thoughts.model_api_controls: use structured data or code for graph state when reliability matters. Prefer provider reasoning/thinking controls for single-path jobs; reserve graph search for multi-path synthesis with evals.
graph-of-thoughts.failure_modes:
graph bloat, weak conflict resolution, hidden dependency errors.
 Overusing graph search when API reasoning controls would suffice.
graph-of-thoughts.caveat: graph management is more reliable outside a single prompt.
graph-of-thoughts.best_use: synthesis, multi-document reasoning, and tasks where independent strands recombine.
graph-of-thoughts.avoid_when: the task is linear or small.

meta-prompting.model_api_controls: pair with an eval set; do not select by plausibility alone; survey-tier PE literature (e.g. Prompt Report arXiv:2406.06608) is ideation context, not a license to ship unmeasured prompts.
meta-prompting.failure_modes: longer prompts with no measurable gain, overfitting to visible examples.
meta-prompting.caveat: meta-prompting is ideation; optimization requires measurement.
meta-prompting.best_use: exploring prompt variants, rubrics, and failure hypotheses before eval.
meta-prompting.avoid_when: generated prompts will be trusted without held-out tests.

sources.title: Large Language Models are Human-Level Prompt Engineers

multimodal-evidence-reasoning.model_api_controls: image detail setting, multimodal model, OCR/tool support; follow official multimodal prompting strategies (e.g. Gemini prompting strategies) for input framing.
multimodal-evidence-reasoning.failure_modes: hallucinated visual details, weak spatial reasoning, missing crop context.
multimodal-evidence-reasoning.caveat: this card avoids public long CoT; it asks for evidence summary.
multimodal-evidence-reasoning.best_use:
screenshots, charts, tables, diagrams, and image-question answering.
 Prefer evidence-summary contracts over public long CoT for visual claims.
multimodal-evidence-reasoning.avoid_when: the model lacks vision support or the image evidence is not needed.

panelgpt.model_api_controls:
retrieval/citations, structured evidence fields, and review gates for factual or high-stakes work.
 Label outputs as simulated panel critique; production multi-agent work needs official agent/tool/eval controls.
panelgpt.failure_modes: fabricated expertise, irrelevant roles, groupthink, false authority, unsupported consensus.
panelgpt.caveat: simulated reviewers can improve perspective coverage, but they are not independent experts. For formal decision prep with explicit critique, see [Expert Panel Discussion](#expert-panel-discussion).
panelgpt.best_use: exploratory brainstorming or decision preparation where perspective coverage matters.
panelgpt.avoid_when: synthetic consensus would be mistaken for expert review or when a simpler verification pass is enough.

sources.title: Personas in System Prompts Do Not Improve Performance

plan-and-solve-prompting.model_api_controls: use higher reasoning effort for hard planning when supported. When available, prefer provider reasoning controls for planning-heavy tasks rather than forcing long public plans.
plan-and-solve-prompting.failure_modes: bad plans, stale assumptions, plan-following without correction.
plan-and-solve-prompting.caveat: a plan is useful only if it changes execution or checks.
plan-and-solve-prompting.best_use: multi-step tasks where missing a step is more likely than arithmetic/tool failure.

rag-citation-grounded-answering.model_api_controls: retrieval query, source ranking, grounding metadata, provider citation controls, citation validator, context budget, faithfulness/attribution evals (pair with eval harness for production RAG).
rag-citation-grounded-answering.failure_modes: retrieval miss, source poisoning, citation mismatch, unverified generated citations, lost middle effects, free-form "cite sources" without retrieval/attribution contracts.
rag-citation-grounded-answering.caveat: citations must be checked against source text; model-generated citations can be wrong.
rag-citation-grounded-answering.best_use: current facts, private documents, research synthesis, support answers, and compliance-sensitive summaries.
rag-citation-grounded-answering.avoid_when: retrieval quality is unknown and no review path exists.

sources.title: NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile

self-refine.model_api_controls: Use a rubric, evaluator model, provider evals platform, or human feedback for higher-stakes work. Do not accept refine loops on plausibility alone — pair with eval gates before promotion.
self-refine.failure_modes: circular critique, style drift, over-editing, shipping refined text without regression/eval checks.
self-refine.caveat: one or two loops are usually enough without external feedback.
self-refine.best_use: writing, code review, rubric-based improvement, and creative refinement.
self-refine.avoid_when: critique has no objective standard or stopping condition.

tree-of-thoughts.model_api_controls: Use sampling, external scoring, or multi-call orchestration for genuine search. Do not treat ToT as a substitute for provider thinking/reasoning controls on single-pass jobs; ToT is deliberate multi-path search with cost tradeoffs.
tree-of-thoughts.cost_latency: high — branching multi-call search is much more expensive than single-pass provider reasoning controls.
tree-of-thoughts.failure_modes: expensive exploration, weak self-evaluation, missed paths, using ToT when a reasoning-control single pass would suffice.
tree-of-thoughts.caveat: single-prompt ToT is not the full algorithm.
tree-of-thoughts.best_use: puzzles, planning, creative problem solving, and branching tasks.
tree-of-thoughts.avoid_when: direct answering is sufficient or branching cost is too high.

zero-shot-chain-of-thought.model_api_controls: Prefer provider reasoning/thinking controls when available (OpenAI reasoning effort/summary, Anthropic extended thinking budget, Gemini thinking config) instead of asking for long public CoT. Use visible step lists only when the deliverable itself is a teachable procedure and evals allow it.
zero-shot-chain-of-thought.failure_modes: unfaithful explanations, higher harmfulness in sensitive settings, extra tokens with marginal gain, conflating classic CoT prompting with modern provider reasoning APIs.
zero-shot-chain-of-thought.caveat: Classic visible CoT evidence is task- and model-generation-sensitive; for current models, treat reasoning as an API control surface first (see OpenAI reasoning, Anthropic extended thinking, Gemini thinking docs).
zero-shot-chain-of-thought.best_use: older or non-reasoning models on arithmetic, symbolic, or logic tasks where concise rationale helps debugging.
zero-shot-chain-of-thought.avoid_when:
modern reasoning controls, safety-sensitive tasks, or final-answer schemas are better.
 Prefer private reasoning controls over paste-template "think step by step" for production tool/agent jobs.
